description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_csv' that implements a database driver for CSV files as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for connecting, executing queries, and retrieving metadata, tailored specifically for CSV-based data access.

classes.name: ADODB_csv
classes.description: Database driver class for accessing CSV files through a URL-based mechanism as part of the ADOdb PHP library.

classes.name: ADORecordset_csv
classes.description: Class representing a recordset returned from CSV data source, extends ADORecordSet.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Returns the last inserted ID, stored in the class property.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows from the last operation.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Indicates that database metadata is unsupported, returns false.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes connection using a URL if the hostname starts with 'http://'.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection similar to _connect.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Indicates that metadata of columns is unsupported, returns false.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SELECT query with limit and offset, returning a recordset.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, with support for parameter binding, returning a recordset.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the connection, here always returning true for resource cleanup.
